reason: A focused native language-cycle button blurs when disabled during locale loading. Restore its focus after completion only if the user has not focused another control; preserve standard popup-menu behavior. Only Shop has verified public release registration in this initiative.

title.en: Keep keyboard focus after changing language
title.ar: الحفاظ على تركيز لوحة المفاتيح بعد تغيير اللغة

summary.en: The language button keeps keyboard focus when the selected language finishes loading.
summary.ar: يحتفظ زر اللغة بتركيز لوحة المفاتيح بعد اكتمال تحميل اللغة المختارة.

details.en: Focus stays with a different control if you move away while the language is loading.
details.ar: يبقى التركيز على أي حقل آخر تنتقل إليه أثناء تحميل اللغة.
